# 4 Ezra Chapter 14 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 14:6 — the two-tier revelation to Moses

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "These-words-you-shall-publish-openly, and-these-you-shall-hide" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "These words you shall publish openly, and these you shall hide" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "Some of these words you will publish openly; others you will keep hidden" | Rephrased |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "These words you shall publish openly, and these you shall hide" (LOGOS). The demonstrative contrast (these...these) is important to preserve.

---

## 14:24 — Ezra's request for the Holy Spirit

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "send-into-me-the-Holy-Spirit" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "send into me the Holy Spirit" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "breathe your Holy Spirit into me" | "Breathe into me" is more vivid and echoes Gen 2:7 |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Send into me the Holy Spirit" (LOGOS). The Latin immitte is "send into" not "breathe"; PNEUMA's echo of Genesis creation is evocative but not in the source.

---

## 14:42 — the cup's effect

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "my-heart-poured-forth-understanding, and-wisdom-grew-in-my-chest, for-my-spirit-retained-its-memory" | Full literal |
| LOGOS | "my heart poured forth understanding, and wisdom grew in my breast, for my spirit retained its memory" | Same in natural English |
| PNEUMA | "understanding poured out from my heart and wisdom swelled in my chest — my spirit was holding on to everything" | Slight paraphrase |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "My heart poured forth understanding, and wisdom grew in my breast, for my spirit retained its memory" (LOGOS). The three distinct clauses (understanding/wisdom/memory) should all be preserved separately.

---

## 14:47–50 — 24 public books + 70 secret books

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "ninety-four-books...twenty-four openly...seventy-last" | Correct: 24 + 70 = 94 |
| LOGOS | "ninety-four books...The first...publish openly...keep the seventy last" | Correct — "first" implies 24 (the Hebrew canon) |
| PNEUMA | "ninety-four books...publish the first twenty-four...keep the last seventy" | Spells out "twenty-four" explicitly |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS for vv. 47-48 but adopt PNEUMA's explicit "twenty-four" at v. 48 since it clarifies the canonical reckoning for readers. "The first that you have written publish openly" preserves the original; PNEUMA's "first twenty-four" is a gloss but helpful.

---

## 14:50 — spring/fountain/stream of wisdom

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-spring-of-understanding, the-fountain-of-wisdom, and-the-stream-of-knowledge" | Full triple |
| LOGOS | "the spring of understanding, the fountain of wisdom, and the stream of knowledge" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "the spring of understanding, the fountain of wisdom, and the stream of knowledge" | Identical |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Unanimous — "the spring of understanding, the fountain of wisdom, and the stream of knowledge." This is one of the most beautiful lines in the book and all three translators agree exactly.

---

## Total disagreements: 4 (one unanimous)
